+# FINDING F3 (new, pre-existing, discovered during F2 fix verification 2026-06-11)
+
+**Symptom:** under `UPAT_COMPILE=0` (interpreted pattern dispatch), ANY graph that reaches
+codegen crashes: `NameError: name 'do_substitute' is not defined` at
+tinygrad/codegen/simplify.py:57. Even `Tensor.arange(16).sum().item()` crashes.
+
+**Proven pre-existing:** reproduced at BASE `83971860d` (pre-F2-fix worktree) with the
+trivial smoke above. NOT caused by the F2 harvest fix — the F2 fix merely unshadowed it
+in our PCONTIG=3 repro (pre-fix, remove_bufferize crashed first at schedule stage with
+the AxisType NameError; post-fix execution proceeds to codegen and hits this one).
+
+**Mechanism (distinct from F2 — timing, not depth):** `pm_simplify_ranges`
+(simplify.py:52-58) is constructed at module-import time; its SINK lambda references
+`do_substitute`, which is defined at simplify.py:63 — AFTER the table. Under
+UPAT_COMPILE=0, `PatternMatcher.__init__` calls `upat_interpret` EAGERLY (uop/ops.py,
+`entry[1] = ... if compiled else upat_interpret(p, fxn)`), which runs
+`deconstruct_function` immediately — snapshotting pruned globals while `do_substitute`
+is not yet in the module dict. Under the default UPAT_COMPILE=1, `upat_deferred_compile`
+defers deconstruction to the first match (post-import), so the name is present.
+`pm_split_ranges` (simplify.py:68-71) has the same forward reference.
+
+**Scope:** UPAT_COMPILE=0 is a non-default debug flag; CI does not set it. Default-path
+users unaffected. Candidate fixes (NOT implemented, not in scope of the F2 branch):
+move `do_substitute` above the tables, or make upat_interpret deconstruct lazily on
+first call like the compiled path. A regression test would set UPAT_COMPILE=0 and
+realize a trivial tensor.
+
+**Status:** documented only. Dedupe: no open issue found mentioning do_substitute or
+UPAT_COMPILE=0 import-order. Candidate second PR after F2.
